Inputs: Save primary sources HD-01, additional files of the same commit, historical BIP32-vectors, fixed 83 decision-making HD-01. SHA-256 copy Git blob Of the solutions, only minors are used i−1 bits children; public-point Puzzle They don't replace the starting points.

Plan: follow-up GUI → Vault → Schema → HDKeychain, export and order; check leading zeros, invalid child, version/depth/fingerprint, inheritance/repeat keychains. Comparing the independent Python-Archival vector model: check for differences with selected final examples; standard HMAC-Additivity is not considered a new attack.

Budget before launches: one CPU-process; every control ≤120 seconds, the whole set ≤300 seconds; ≤2048 commonplace EC-derivations ≤65536 small convertible elements, ≤512 artificially defined boundary cases, in the absence of new recovery-hypotheses master/seed/Keep separate tracks run ID, inputs, outputs, times; complete identical launches do not repeat GUI/full-on C++-The assembly is not considered to have been completed without actually starting.

New contribution relative to HD-01: specific CoinDB paths serialization/identity, Interaccount dependencies, verification of historical implementation behavior: conditional result requires explicit description of the missing artifact; uniqueness of the key does not equal cheap recovery.
